name: azad-preview-mode
description: Device preview (phone / desktop dummy website) for azAd HTML ads, served via jsDelivr.
author: Christoph Eckert <christoph@behring5.de>

scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map src/azPreview.scss dist/azPreview.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed src/azPreview.scss dist/azPreview.min.css
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:banner
